questions.q: According to General Relativity, why does the Earth orbit the Sun?
options: The Sun exerts an invisible tethering force on the Earth.
The Earth is following a straight path through curved spacetime.
The Sun emits gravitons that pull the Earth inward.
questions.explanation: In General Relativity, massive objects warp spacetime, and other objects simply follow the straightest path (geodesic) through that curved geometry.
